paragraphs.source_en: “What story is Miss Yukie telling? I love stories more than anything.” It was Tonko who said this. “Is it the story of Kachi-kachi Mountain again?” It was Sunko who asked that. “Boba tells a story too.” So said the youngest girl, pushing forward between her two elder sisters. By this, however, she did not mean that she wanted to hear someone tell a story, but that she too meant to tell them one. One of her sisters said, “Oh dear, Boba is telling another story.” The master's wife coaxed her, “Be a good girl. Tell your story later, after Miss Yukie has finished hers.” But Boba would have none of that, and cried out angrily, “No! Babu!” Yukie, for her part, yielded politely and said, “Very well, very well, Boba shall go first. What story will you tell?”
